fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Device Name
fields.help: Specifies a unique device name of your choice that is reflected into the /dev/disk/by-id/google-* tree of a Linux operating system running within the instance.

fields.label: Disk
fields.help: name or self_link of the disk that will be attached.

fields.label: Instance
fields.help: name or self_link of the compute instance that the disk will be attached to.

fields.label: Interface
fields.help: The disk interface used for attaching this disk.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: The mode in which to attach this disk, either READ_WRITE or READ_ONLY.

fields.label: Project
fields.help: The project that the referenced compute instance is a part of.

fields.label: Zone
fields.help: The zone that the referenced compute instance is located within.
